title: Detecting bus delays and service anomalies in Niter\'oi with autoencoder latent feature representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.35710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bus riders judge service by two failures: single trips that run late, and days on which the whole system misbehaves. We ask whether one unsupervised representation of raw GPS telemetry can serve both diagnoses on the NetMob 2026 Niter\'oi bus dataset. An autoencoder compresses each trip into a 64-dimensional latent vector; the frozen encoder feeds supervised delay classifiers, and the reconstruction error serves as an anomaly score. Two findings are negative. First, the latent representation does not improve delay detection: gradient boosting on per-trip summary features reaches $0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC against $0.838 \pm 0.016$ for the best latent setup, and the gap becomes significant once the preprocessing filters are relaxed. Second, two of the three external checks of the anomaly score were circular. translated_title: 使用自编码器潜在特征表示检测尼泰罗伊的公交车延误与服务异常
translated_abstract: 公交乘客通常通过两类故障来评判服务质量：个别班次晚点，以及整个系统在某天整体失灵。我们探讨在 NetMob 2026 尼泰罗伊公交数据集上，一种针对原始 GPS 遥测数据的无监督表示能否同时服务于这两种诊断。自编码器将每次行程压缩为 64 维潜在向量；冻结的编码器为有监督的延误分类器提供特征，而重建误差则作为异常分数。研究结果中有两点是否定的。第一，潜在表示并未改善延误检测：基于单次行程摘要特征的梯度提升方法达到 0.846 ± 0.013 的 ROC-AUC，而最佳潜在设置为 0.838 ± 0.016，且一旦放宽预处理过滤器，这一差距变得显著。第二，异常分数的三项外部验证中有两项存在循环论证。在不使用降雨信息的情况下重新训练后，降雨关联消失（标记比例 5.4% 对 5.0%，p = 0.84），以及一次表面上波及全城的……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现自编码器潜在表示在公交车延误检测上并不优于传统人工特征，且异常分数的多项外部验证存在循环论证，表明单一无监督表示难以同时胜任单程延误检测与全系统异常诊断。
en_tdlr: This study finds that autoencoder latent representations do not outperform conventional per-trip features for bus delay detection, and that external validations of the anomaly score were circular, showing a single unsupervised representation struggles to serve both trip-level delay detection and system-wide anomaly diagnosis.
